A collection of tools, data sources, and learning materials I recommend to students and use in my own research. **Students starting out:** begin with the *Learn to Code* and *Economics Data* sections.

---

## Learn to Code

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### 🟣 Julia Academy

Free courses for programming, machine learning, and data science. Start here if you have never coded before.

🔗 [Link](https://juliaacademy.com/courses)
:::

::: {.card}
### 📘 QuantEcon

Open lectures on quantitative economics with Julia and Python — the single best bridge between economics and programming.

🔗 [Link](https://quantecon.org)
:::

::: {.card}
### 💻 Learn C++

Tutorials for when you need serious speed (structural models, large simulations).

🔗 [Link](https://www.learncpp.com)
:::

:::

---

## Economics Data

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### 🇺🇸 FRED

Federal Reserve Economic Data — the first stop for macro time series. Free, with API access.

🔗 [Link](https://fred.stlouisfed.org)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🇬🇧 ONS & Bank of England

UK official statistics and the Bank's interactive statistical database.

🔗 [ONS](https://www.ons.gov.uk) · [BoE Database](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database/)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🌍 World Bank Open Data

Cross-country development and macro indicators.

🔗 [Link](https://data.worldbank.org)
:::

:::

---

## Math and Statistics Notes

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### 📊 Math & Probability Notes

Lecture materials and notes on probability theory.

🔗 [Link](https://math.dartmouth.edu/~prob/prob/prob.pdf)
:::

::: {.card}
### 📈 Bayesian Econometrics

Applied Bayesian Econometrics for Central Bankers — practical and code-driven.

🔗 [Link](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/ccbs/applied-bayesian-econometrics-for-central-bankers-updated-2017)
:::

:::

---

## LaTeX & Writing

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### ✍️ Overleaf

Online LaTeX editor — what you will write your dissertation in.

🔗 [Link](https://www.overleaf.com)
:::

::: {.card}
### 📐 LaTeX Table Generator

Easy table builder for LaTeX.

🔗 [Link](https://www.tablesgenerator.com/latex_tables)
:::

::: {.card}
### ✏️ Hemingway Editor

Improve clarity and readability of writing.

🔗 [Link](https://hemingwayapp.com)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🤖 QuillBot

Paraphrasing and writing assistant.

🔗 [Link](https://quillbot.com)
:::

:::

## References Tools

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### 🔗 DOI / BibTeX

Find and format DOIs for references.

🔗 [Link](https://www.doi.org)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🧠 Litmaps

Visual literature mapping tool.

🔗 [Link](https://www.litmaps.com)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🔍 ResearchRabbit

Discover and map academic papers.

🔗 [Link](https://www.researchrabbit.ai)
:::

:::

## Funding, Jobs & Research Opportunities

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.card}
### 💰 INOMICS

Economics jobs, funding, and summer schools — useful for MSc students planning a PhD.

🔗 [Link](https://inomics.com)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🌐 EconJobMarket

The central platform for academic economics job applications.

🔗 [Link](https://econjobmarket.org)
:::

::: {.card}
### 🎓 Research Professional

Funding and research opportunities database.

🔗 [Link](https://www.researchprofessional.com)
:::
